title: Bloom Library: Multimodal Datasets in 300+ Languages for a Variety of Downstream Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the domain and topic distribution of the books in the dataset, specifically identifying an overrepresentation of Christian books and Bible stories compared to other topics.

Qualitative assessment of dataset sources, noting that the underlying text and audio content for given local languages is often produced by a very small number of individuals, organizations, or speakers.
